system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A unified instruction build system generates CLI-specific instruction files from shared templates
system_prompt_style.note: instructions/common + roles + cli_specific built per CLI/role into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.opencode/agents/*.md

env_context_strategy.note: Underlying CLIs explore the repo; project context files injected optionally.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: YAML slimming utility — `scripts/slim_yaml.sh` archives read messages and terminal commands
context_compaction.note: Context is reset with /clear rather than compacted; underlying CLI context handling not documented here.

observation_format.note: YAML/text files plus screenshot images read by agents.

tool_call_format.note: Tool-calling is delegated to the underlying CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, etc.); shogun itself orchestrates via shell scripts and YAML.

edit_primitive.note: Editing primitives come from the underlying CLI (Claude Code Write/Edit).

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers extend Claude's capabilities.
tool_schema_source.note: Harness itself ships no tool schemas; tools come from CLIs and MCP servers.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Agents talk to each other by writing YAML files — like passing notes. **No polling loops, no wasted API calls.**
loop_primitives.note: Karo decomposes into subtasks (plan_execute) and delivery is inotify event-driven.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The Karo assigns each subtask a Bloom level and routes it to the appropriate agent.
planning_granularity.note: Subtasks stored as YAML in queue/tasks/ with blockedBy dependencies.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the Shogun → Karo → Ashigaru chain of command prevents conflicts by design

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each agent has its own inbox file — no cross-talk
delegation_mechanism.note: YAML mailbox + tmux nudge; agents are pre-spawned panes, not spawned per task.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Appears in dashboard.md → You approve → Skill created in .claude/commands/
human_in_loop.note: Human is the Lord issuing commands and approving skill candidates; per-action permission is bypassed.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Layer 3: YAML Queue | `queue/shogun_to_karo.yaml`, `queue/tasks/`, `queue/reports/` | Task management — source of truth

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Shogun reads `memory/MEMORY.md` at every session start.
long_term_memory.note: Memory MCP jsonl graph = episodic store; skills/ = skill library.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Old cmds remain in `queue/` as history, and the Shogun restores state when resumed

self_verification.evidence_quote: Karo | Sonnet | Enabled | Task distribution, simple QC, dashboard management
self_verification.note: Karo/Gunshi perform quality review of Ashigaru reports (separate agent review); Ashigaru run test commands.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Karo reviews the E2E plan, checks prerequisites, and makes the final pass/fail judgment
retry_policy.note: Redo loop implied (tests/e2e/e2e_redo.bats); no fixed cap documented.

rollback.note: Branch policy / auto-merge scripts imply git workflow; no explicit rollback documented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Phase 3 | 4+ min | Send CLI-specific context reset
termination_condition.note: Tasks end when agent reports done; stall escalation resets rather than terminates the system.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: you can configure **model-level routing within the Ashigaru tier**
cost_controls.note: Flat-rate CLI subscriptions instead of token budget; /clear used to cut context cost.

timeouts.evidence_quote: `send-keys` transmits only a short wake-up signal (timeout 5s)

execution_isolation.note: Agents are CLI processes in tmux panes on the host (WSL2/Linux).

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: This system manages **all white-collar tasks**, not just code. Projects can live anywhere on your filesystem.
filesystem_access.note: OpenCode role permissions scope queue files only, per config/opencode-permissions.yaml.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Search for evidence before making decisions. Agents don't rely solely on their training data — they actively research using web search

permission_model.evidence_quote: Agents should start with each CLI's unattended permission settings.
permission_model.note: `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`; OpenCode role file permissions are a config-reachable allowlist.

tracing.evidence_quote: Every instruction, report, and decision is a plain YAML file you can read, diff, and version-control.

replayability.evidence_quote: Open any `.yaml` file to see exact message history
replayability.note: History is inspectable; no replay runner documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: E2E test suite (19 tests, 7 scenarios)** — Mock CLI framework simulates agent behavior in isolated tmux sessions
eval_hooks.note: Self-tests, not an external benchmark harness; tests/bloom_classification_accuracy.sh evaluates routing.

guardrails.evidence_quote: config/opencode-permissions.yaml` drives OpenCode frontmatter permissions so each role can read/write only the files it owns
guardrails.note: instructions/common/forbidden_actions.md also constrains actions via prompt.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Run 10 AI coding agents in parallel
target_domain.note: Also markets 'all white-collar tasks' and task management (SayTask).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Supports **Claude Code**, **OpenAI Codex**, **GitHub Copilot**, **Kimi Code**, **OpenCode**, **Cursor**, and **Antigravity**.
